title: 第2530章 凌渊可能出事了第2529章 万宝楼内部的变故
content_zh:
这一查，陆宸也觉得黑衣人救慕容雪的招式有那么一些眼熟，但一下又想不起来。
陆宸不语，闭上眼睛冥想，把上一世的记忆都过了一遍，终是锁定了一个人。
此人名为齐天云，来自云澜大陆，年轻时是云澜大陆第一天骄，武道天赋极高。
上一世，齐天云也参加过封号武帝之战，虽然没有拿到名次，但也是打出了自己的威名。
而他和慕容雪之所以会觉得齐天云招式有些眼熟，根本原因就是在封号武帝之战中看过他出手，对他那超强的战力有印象。
“如果为师没看走眼的话，救你的人是齐天云！”
过了好一会，陆宸睁眼，说出了自己的猜测。
慕容雪愣了一下，随即很快想起了齐天云，道：“师尊，是云澜大陆的那个百叶剑帝？”
陆宸没有回答，反问道：“老七，像不像他？”
慕容雪思索着说道：“有几分相似！”
陆宸道：“或许是怕被报复，他刻意隐藏了自己的剑道，也没用大杀招百叶齐飞，但你我都是剑修，还是能从中看出一些路数的。”
“是的，您这一说，徒儿也是越想越像。”慕容雪道。
陆宸疑惑道：“可为师当年和齐天云并无故交，他为何要冒着大风险救你和小子夜？”
“徒儿也是不解。”慕容雪摇头。
陆宸又问道：“老七，你就在他的帮助下逃走了？”
慕容雪苦涩道：“那个神秘人让我们先走，他垫后，徒儿便带着子夜师侄逃走。”
“可惜的是，很快又有一批人追上了我们，徒儿没办法，只能和追上来的人血战，让子夜师侄逃走，把情况告诉四师兄。”
“然后呢？”陆宸问。
慕容雪道：“后来徒儿重伤逃走，四处躲避追杀，不知不觉就逃到了太阴圣宫的地盘。”
“之后，就在徒儿以为自己在劫难逃时，太阴圣宫的李玄衣出现了，救下了徒儿。”

“这倒是和我知道的对上了。”陆宸说。
慕容雪好奇的问道：“师尊，有人和您说过？”
陆宸解释道：“在天荒秘境历练时，为师救下了一个太阴圣宫的人，问了一下你为何在太阴圣宫，她就告诉为师了。”
慕容雪道：“师尊，其实救下徒儿最重要的人是南宫灵。”
“等会？你说谁？”陆宸很是意外。
慕容雪看着陆宸笑着说：“师尊，您没有听错，就是您这一世的妻子，南宫灵。”
“这怎么又和灵儿扯上了？”陆宸疑惑的问。
慕容雪道：“最先发现徒儿被人追杀的是华滢，她带着师母不知从何处回来。”
“发现徒儿被追杀，她冷笑嘲讽，而师母一听是逍遥武帝一脉的人，立刻逼华滢救徒儿。”
“华滢看中师母的武道天赋，尽管恨不得徒儿死，她也不得不答应救徒儿。”
“可是您也知道，以华滢的实力根本救不了徒儿，于是她就把李玄衣叫来了。”
“原来是这样！”陆宸明白过来。
慕容雪后怕道：“是啊，要不是师母，徒儿也死了。”
陆宸笑道：“这也算是你命不该绝，误打误撞上了。”
想到一件事，慕容雪笑问道：“师尊，不知师母可知您是曾经的逍遥武帝？”
content_en:
After checking, Lu Chen also felt that the man in black's move to save Murong Xue was somewhat familiar, but he couldn't remember it at the same time.
Lu Chen remained silent, closed his eyes and meditated, going through the memories of his previous life, and finally locked onto one person.
This person's name is Qi Tianyun, and he comes from Yunlan Continent. When he was young, he was the most talented person in Yunlan Continent, and his martial arts talent was extremely high.
In the last life, Qi Tianyun also participated in the battle to be titled Martial Emperor. Although he did not get the ranking, he still made his own reputation.
The fundamental reason why he and Murong Xue felt that Qi Tianyun's moves looked familiar was that they had seen Qi Tianyun's moves in the Battle of the Titled Martial Emperor and were impressed by his super combat power.
"If my teacher is not mistaken, the person who saves you is Qi Tianyun!"
After a while, Lu Chen opened his eyes and expressed his guess.
Murong Xue was stunned for a moment, then quickly remembered Qi Tianyun and said, "Master, is this the Baiye Sword Emperor from Yunlan Continent?"
Lu Chen did not answer, but asked: "Lao Qi, do you look like him?"
Murong Xue thought thoughtfully and said, "It's somewhat similar!"
Lu Chen said: "Perhaps he was afraid of retaliation, so he deliberately hid his swordsmanship, and did not use his ultimate killing move, Hundred Leaves Flying Together. But you and I are both swordsmen, so we can still see some clues from it."
"Yes, when you say this, the more I think about it, the more similar I become." Murong Xue said.
Lu Chen wondered: "But my teacher and Qi Tianyun didn't have any friendship back then. Why did he take such a big risk to save you and Xiao Ziye?"
"Disciple is also puzzled." Murong Xue shook her head.
Lu Chen asked again: "Lao Qi, you escaped with his help?"
Murong Xue said bitterly: "The mysterious man asked us to leave first. He took the lead, and my disciple fled with nephew Ziye."
"Unfortunately, another group of people caught up with us soon. My disciple had no choice but to fight bloody battles with the people who caught up with us, and let Senior Nephew Ziye escape and inform Fourth Senior Brother of the situation."
"Then what?" Lu Chen asked.
Murong Xue said: "Later, my disciple was seriously injured and escaped, running around to avoid being chased and killed, and unknowingly escaped to the territory of Taiyin Holy Palace."
"Later, just when the disciple thought he was doomed, Li Xuanyi from the Taiyin Holy Palace appeared and rescued the disciple."
"This is consistent with what I know." Lu Chen said.
Murong Xue asked curiously: "Master, someone told you?"
Lu Chen explained: "When I was training in the Tianhuang Secret Realm, I rescued a person from the Taiyin Holy Palace. I asked why you were in the Taiyin Holy Palace, and she told me."
Murong Xue said: "Master, actually the most important person who saved my disciple is Nangong Ling."
"Wait a minute? Who are you talking about?" Lu Chen was very surprised.
Murong Xue looked at Lu Chen and said with a smile: "Master, you heard me right, she is your wife in this life, Nangong Ling."
"Why is this related to Ling'er again?" Lu Chen asked doubtfully.
Murong Xue said: "The first person who discovered that our disciple was being hunted was Hua Ying. She came back from nowhere with her master's wife."
"When she found out that her disciple was being hunted, she sneered and taunted her. When the master's wife heard that he was from Emperor Xiaoyao's lineage, she immediately forced Hua Ying to save her disciple."
"Hua Ying took a fancy to her master's martial arts talent. Even though she wished for her disciple's death, she had no choice but to agree to save him."
"But you also know that Hua Ying's strength can't save her disciple at all, so she called Li Xuanyi."
"So that's it!" Lu Chen understood.
Empress Murong Xue said fearfully: "Yes, if it weren't for Master's wife, my disciple would also be dead."
Lu Chen smiled and said: "This can be considered as your fate was not meant to be cut off, and you bumped into it by mistake."
Thinking of something, Murong Xuexiao asked: "Master, I wonder if my wife knows that you were the former Xiaoyao Martial Emperor?"
